note: Set A invents entities that do not appear in the legends (FFA-W3-3, FFA-W3-2, SNL-FFA) and attaches roughly a dozen lift, drag and L/D values to them, including contradictory pairs (e.g., FFA-W3-3 max cl/cd given as both 120 and 110, FFA-W3-2 as both 80 and 120), so those claims are unsupported and misbound. Set B keeps only the seven airfoils actually plotted, correctly binds the Re values from the legends, and gives peak cl/cd values (~120, 110, 100, 95, 90, 75 for the FFA-W3 series, ~20-25 for SNL-FFA-W3-500) that match the lift-to-drag panel. Set A's remaining legend/axis claims and a few plot readings are fine, but its cl=2.0 at 20 deg for SNL-FFA-W3-500 over-reads the curve. Set B's only weakness is that several cl/cd claims quote only the legend entry rather than the plotted value, and it duplicates a couple of peak-L/D claims.
